title: Inter at San Siro: Four With Italy, One With France — Thuram's Tests Show No Tear
description:
Inter shouldn't lend San Siro to Italy — but tonight they do, with five Inter men in the two squads.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=72

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Four Inter men are with Italy for tonight (Barella, Bastoni, Dimarco, Esposito) and Andy Diouf is with France. Source: Inter.it, Nov 11.
CONFIRMED — Inter Women host Juventus on Sunday at the Stadio Ernesto Breda, and entry is free. Source: Inter.it, Nov 11.
REPORTED — Marcus Thuram's tests showed a minor hamstring problem and no tear; he hopes to be back at Atalanta on Nov 22. Source: Gazzetta dello Sport via Football Italia, Nov 11.
REPORTED — Carlos Augusto's renewal is said to be stuck on money, with his agents asking up to EUR 5m a year. Source: Nicolo Schira via FCInterNews, Nov 10.
